### Operational discipline is a critical determinant of clinical utility for neurologic monoclonal antibodies


In neurologic mAb development, the therapies that reach patients will be those designed not only to work, but to be delivered. Discover how operational discipline is emerging as a key differentiator in translating scientific advances into clinical utility.
